vendor/ffmpeg/ffmpeg.exe  (+ LICENSE.txt) - optional, bundled into the build by visionpro.spec.
Not committed to git (170 MB). Download a Windows 64-bit build from
https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases (ffmpeg-master-latest-win64-gpl.zip)
and copy bin\ffmpeg.exe and LICENSE.txt here. ffprobe.exe is only needed for tests\check_recording.py.
